lines.trans: I know that it is not easy.
We each have our temperament, it is human.
We agreed that I would manage my pregnancy alone.
I care about the health of my employees.
Yes, I thank you for your benevolence.
I remain at your disposal for your leave.
I will ask you when I feel the need.
It is noted. Is everything going well with your partner?
Very well, thank you.
I am delighted. Pass along my warm regards to her.
I will not fail to do so.
Have a good day, Andrea.
Cordially, Hicham.
I am going to see Jean Dujardin now.
Take care of yourself on the road.
Do not worry, I manage everything.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.trans: Pass along my regards to her.

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: elle a besoin d'aide = she needs help
as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of

examples.text: Je te remercie de ta bienveillance.
examples.trans: I thank you for your benevolence.

meanings.note: as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...

meanings.en: bonne journée = have a nice day

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Tout va bien avec ta compagne?
examples.trans: Is everything going well with your partner?

meanings.en: leave, time off from work (congé de maternité = maternity leave)

examples.text: Elle est en congé cette semaine.
examples.trans: She is on leave this week.

meanings.en: cordially, warmly; formal sign-off in correspondence

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.note: dire la vérité à quelqu'un = to tell someone the truth
preposition: en vacances, en huit ans
pronoun before the verb: j'en ai assez, je n'en peux plus
c'est facile de + infinitive: it's easy to

meanings.en: to pay attention, take care, watch out

examples.trans: To pay attention to the road.

meanings.note: une première grossesse = a first pregnancy
c'est moi qui gère = I'm handling it
the whole day as it passes; bonne journée = have a nice day
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

meanings.en: to be missed by (tu me manques = I miss you)
meanings.note: back to front: the person missed is the subject
object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille
merci beaucoup = thank you very much
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

examples.text: Notez tout ce que je dis.

meanings.note: everyday speech, with a he/she verb form

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

meanings.note: tu viens quand? = when are you coming?

examples.text: Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir.
C'est comme ça que tu me remercies?
examples.trans: Is this how you thank me?

meanings.en: to feel, experience, perceive (a sensation or emotion)

examples.trans: When I will feel the need.

examples.text: Ne restez pas là à ne rien faire!
examples.trans: Don't just stay there doing nothing!

meanings.en: rester là à + infinitive = to stay there doing

examples.trans: Do you know where he is?

savoir.gloss: to know; to know how to

meanings.note: je ne sais pas = I don't know
before the noun: le seul agent

meanings.en: to care about, worry about, pay heed to (usually pronominal se soucier de)

examples.text: Je me soucie de mes employés.
Il ne se soucie de rien.
examples.trans: He does not care about anything.

examples.text: Le livre est sur la table.
examples.trans: The book is on the table.

meanings.note: sur la table, sur la route
before the verb; t' before a vowel
used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi
informal, one owner; ton, ta, tes

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone

meanings.en: to transmit, pass along, convey, forward

examples.trans: Pass along my regards to her.

meanings.note: venir de: je viens de la Côte d'Azur
venir de + infinitive: je viens d'arriver = I've just arrived
il y a = there is / there are
j'y pense = I think about it
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
at disposal, on hand, available (rester à disposition = to remain available)
